_comment: Frozen contract (SEC-21, SEC-22; tests/security/test_token_scopes.py; SECSUITE frozen suite). Auth must FAIL CLOSED: removing a service's token configuration turns the door into a 401, never into an open door, and the one documented escape hatch (AI_ENGINE_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED) is OFF unless explicitly set. Both probes are `sec_managed` -- proving a fail-closed default requires DELETING configuration from the service's environment, which only a harness that owns that environment can do, so they AUTO-SKIP in attached mode. That is precisely the hole plan decision 44 hedges: extracting the cases here means `SEC_BOOT_*_CMD` boot mode (planned, ~wk8) can drive them against any language by unsetting the same variables and expecting the same statuses. `unset_scopes` names logical token scopes; the harness maps them to env var names (ai=AI_ENGINE_API_TOKEN, callback=BACKEND_CALLBACK_TOKEN, agent=BACKEND_AGENT_API_TOKEN, browser=BROWSER_ENGINE_API_TOKEN). Changing this file is a security decision: it requires a docs/MODULE_INDEX.md ledger row and a SECSUITE_VERSION bump (see tests/security/README.md).

SEC-21._note: Each case removes the token config a door depends on, sends NO credential, and requires 401. A door that answers 200 with its token config missing is the failure mode this freezes: unconfigured must mean closed, not unguarded. The escape hatch is deleted in every case so it cannot mask the result.

cases._note: callback and ai are unset alongside browser because browser-engine used to ACCEPT them as a cross-scope fallback; that fallback was removed in SECSUITE 1.3.0 and unsetting all three keeps the probe honest if it is ever reintroduced.

SEC-22._note: AI_ENGINE_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED is a real escape hatch, and the probe proves BOTH halves: absent means closed (401) and present means open. The second half is the non-vacuity check -- without it, a service that 401'd unconditionally (or had no embedding route at all) would pass the first half for the wrong reason. 'Open' is observable only as a non-401 because the hermetic env has no embedding backend.
